name: DENALI 6 PERSON SAUNA
description: The Denali is designed using the highest quality components that Almost Heaven has to offer. This smooth and luxurious sauna is taller than our standard sauna providing ample room to stand and move around for your complete comfort. The Denali also features our lovely backlit therapeutic pink salt bar backrest, offering not only beauty and a calm peaceful glow, but significant health benefits as well. The long and wide vertical slat benches are designed for sturdiness and comfort, allowing up to six individuals to enjoy at one time. The multi-level seating and L shaped lower bench provide ample room to stretch out and enjoy.
